description.en: The name of the key to delete.
The name specified when you call the [PutDcdnKvNamespace](~~PutDcdnKvNamespace~~) operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn delete-dcdn-kv --namespace ns1 --key test_key_1 --region cn-hangzhou
